activities.activity: Working an overnight shift as a part-time aged-care support worker, assisting residents with personal care, repositioning and hydration, and writing detailed progress notes during quiet periods
Commuting home from the aged-care facility by train and bus, checking text-only messages on the phone and planning the day ahead
Preparing a quiet light breakfast and a cup of tea, eating slowly and keeping noise to a minimum after the night shift
Showering and washing up after the night shift, then tidying the sink area
Closing the curtains, turning on the fan for air circulation, setting a phone alarm for the afternoon and writing a short reminder note before sleep
Sleeping to recover from the night shift, keeping the room dark and quiet
Eating a late flexitarian lunch of reheated rice and vegetables, brewing tea and drinking it while sitting quietly
Washing up and starting a load of laundry in the washing machine, then moving it to the dryer
Working on Master of Social Work coursework at the desk, reading assigned articles on the computer monitor and taking structured written notes
Making an afternoon cup of tea, rinsing the used mug and wiping the bench
Reviewing the weekly budget and cash spending, then sending text-only messages to confirm the next day's plans in writing
Cooking and eating a flexitarian dinner using the induction cooker, then washing up and putting dishes away
Chairing the weekly house meeting from a written agenda, updating the shared chore roster and confirming quiet hours and rent and bill due dates
Folding dry laundry and running the dehumidifier in the bathroom while organising washing supplies
Checking the desk lamp and reorganising study materials and reminders for the coming week
Drafting a social work assignment at the desk on the computer, following a written task list to stay on track
Evening wash, brushing teeth and changing into sleep clothes
Winding down in bed with the light off and the fan on low, doing a short breathing routine and then falling asleep
